name: Spiced Iced Coffee
flavor_notes: This spiced iced coffee features a refreshing contrast of warm cinnamon and ginger with cool ice, sweetened luxuriously with honey.
barista_note: Pour espresso directly over ice to preserve the temperature boundary and prevent watery dilution.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.
preparations.tested_with: Counter Culture Big Trouble or Joe Coffee The Daily

ingredients.notes: For less caffeine, use Half Caff (~90 mg) or Decaf capsules; same flavor.

steps: In your serving glass, combine 1 oz good honey, 0.125 tsp ginger, and 0.125 tsp cinnamon.

Melt the Cometeer capsule (about 5 minutes submerged in hot water, or overnight in the fridge). Pour it directly over the syrups and spices; stir or whisk with a handheld frother until completely dissolved.
Fill the glass with plenty of ice cubes.
Pour cold milk over the ice; stir gently to combine and watch the layers swirl.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.
steps: Add honey, ginger, and cinnamon to a heat-proof glass.
Brew coffee directly into the glass and stir until dissolved.
Allow the mixture to cool slightly.
Fill a cocktail shaker with ice.
Pour the cooled coffee mixture into the shaker and shake vigorously until well-chilled.
Pour the entire contents, including the ice, into a serving glass.

steps: In your serving glass, combine 1 oz good honey, 0.125 tsp ginger, and 0.125 tsp cinnamon.
Dissolve 2 tsp instant espresso in 2 oz (60 ml) hot water directly over the syrups and spices; stir until completely dissolved.
Fill the glass with plenty of ice cubes.
Pour cold milk over the ice; stir gently to combine and watch the layers swirl.
